text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Today is Valentine's Day! Every year, I'd 
just snack on chocolates and chat happily 
with my friends, but... this year is 
different!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Because above all else―― there's someone 
I absolutely must give this to!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to learning from you 
today, Teacher Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're exaggerating. Let's see, 
according to the 'Illustration Order 
Form'—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What we're making are chocolate muffins. 
Except, they aren't your ordinary 
muffins...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a colorful assortment with 
chocolate, strawberry, and matcha flavors!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The main feature is the decoration! A 
flower crown, a "Thank You" plate, the 
same motif as the hair ornament... the 
whole works!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"These muffins are so lovely and gorgeous, 
really showing off Craft's nimble 
fingers."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel your passion to make it 
something amazing."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I wanted to make something that 
makes you go "Woah!" the moment you see 
it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to surprise you, Trainer! I want 
you to think Craft is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then we'll just have to do our best 
to recreate it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"So... where is the actual recipe? There's 
nothing written here besides the 
illustrations."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I'm totally relying on 
Cesario-sensei for that!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I figured that was the case.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
――If that's what you want, I won't go easy 
on you. Are you prepared, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Masteeer! Please teach me. Osu, osu!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—That's it, fold it from the bottom of the 
bowl as you mix... Hey, didn't I tell you 
not to knead it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Like scooping 
goldfish...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. Let's add the milk soon.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Slowly, carefully... pouring in all 
my feelings of 'become delicious'—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh... Is it already this late? It took 
longer than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft, as for the decorations around 
there—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I should start getting the gift 
wrap ready."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaah...! It's finiiished~~.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to be getting 
emotional? Look at the time.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Waaah, is that the time already!? 
Valentine's Day is gonna be over!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, contact Trainer. After that... dash 
with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!! Cesario, thank you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I hope it all gets across.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before curfew, I was called out by 
Rhein Kraft. Wondering what it could be, I 
waited, and then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
S-Safe...! I made it in time, right, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaah, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*, *exhale*... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer. —Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, so, so very much, as 
always!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've packed it full of all my gratitude! 
Please accept it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I made these chocolate muffins together 
with Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So the taste is definitely guaranteed! 
Cesario was seriously amazing, you know~.
choice_data_list: Craft worked really hard too, right?
Craft worked really hard too, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, actually... that's right.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You see, Cesario went into 'on-mode' and 
gave me some encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I scooped up lots of goldfish! 
I tried really hard~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, listening to Rhein Kraft talk 
about making sweets... we spent a lively, 
fun time together.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I got a little too carried away, so it 
took me a bit of time~
choice_data_list: Mind if I take a look now?
Can I take a look now?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the box I received, I gasped in 
delight. Inside was an array of colorful 
mini-muffins, each topped with lavish 
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I tried all kinds of ideas, like 
crafting marzipan and drawing with 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm glad you were surprised!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the flavor comes certified by 
Cesario herself, so eat with peace of 
mind♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle warmth spreads through my chest. 
Thinking of all the time she spent for me, 
and all the feelings she poured into it...
choice_data_list: It feels like such a waste to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm flattered, but—! That just won't do!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, then, then! Let's take a photo 
together!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, it'll stay forever and 
ever."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"My feelings, too... and Trainer's... 
smile!"
choice_data_list: Then let's have Craft join us too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! ...Understood!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's try our best to make it look like a 
selfie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*click*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, it shifted a bit. But—it's a great 
photo♪"
